title: Structure of maize BZR1-type beta-amylase BAM8 provides new insights into its noncatalytic adaptation.
authors: Sun, Fuai; Palayam, Malathy; Shabek, Nitzan
one_liner_zh: 该文解析玉米非催化BZR1型β-淀粉酶BAM8的晶体结构，结合MD模拟研究其结合口袋构象变化，但对象为蛋白-糖底物而非蛋白-DNA互作，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Plant beta-amylase (BAM) proteins play an essential role in growth, development, stress response, and hormone regulation. Despite their typical (beta/alpha)(8) barrel structure as active catalysts in starch breakdown, catalytically inactive BAMs are implicated in diverse yet elusive functions in plants. The noncatalytic BAM7/8 contain N-terminal BZR1 domains and were shown to be involved in the regulation of brassinosteroid signaling and possibly serve as sensors of yet an uncharacterized metabolic signal. While the structures of several catalytically active BAMs have been reported, structural characterization of the catalytically inactive BZR1-type BAMs remain unknown. Here, we determine the crystal structure of beta-amylase domain of Zea mays BAM8/BES1/BZR1-5 and provide comprehensive insights into its noncatalytic adaptation. Using structural-guided comparison combined with biochemical analysis and molecular dynamics simulations, we revealed conformational changes in multiple distinct highly conserved regions resulting in rearrangement of the binding pocket. Altogether, this study adds a new layer of understanding to starch breakdown mechanism and elucidates the acquired adjustments of noncatalytic BZR1-type BAMs as putative regulatory domains and/or metabolic sensors in plants.
abstract_zh: 植物β-淀粉酶（BAM）蛋白在生长、发育、应激反应及激素调控中发挥重要作用。尽管其作为淀粉分解中的活性催化剂具有典型的（β/α）8桶状结构，但无催化活性的BAM在植物中涉及多种且难以捉摸的功能。非催化性BAM7/8含有N端BZR1结构域，并已被证明参与油菜素内酯信号传导的调控，可能还充当尚未表征的代谢信号的传感器。虽然已有几种具有催化活性的BAM结构被报道，但无催化活性的BZR1型BAM的结构特征仍属未知。在此，我们确定了玉米BAM8/BES1/BZR1-5的β-淀粉酶结构域的晶体结构，并对其非催化适应性提供了全面见解。通过结构引导比较结合生化分析和分子动力学模拟，我们揭示了多个不同高度保守区域中的构象变化，导致结合口袋的重排。总体而言，本研究为淀粉分解机制增添了新的理解层面，并阐明了非催化性BZR1型BAM作为植物中推定调控结构域和/或代谢传感器所获得的适应性调整。
